title: Media Executive
description:
Job title: Media Executive
Location: Bristol - hybrid
Hours: Full time, permanent

You're reading this ad, so you're ready to outthink. To take your skills, knowledge and experience beyond what you thought possible. And TMP268 is the place to do it.

TMP268 is a creatively strategic marketing agency, home to the Armed Forces Recruitment Service. Protecting the nation begins here.

And what does that mean for you? It means new challenges to rise to. Being encouraged and empowered to outthink at every opportunity. It means creating industry-first solutions, harnessing emerging tech, and realising AI's potential to create human connection. It means feeling valued for everything you bring. And work you can be proud to call your own, whatever your role.

The role

The Media Executive will play an important role in the agency Media team, assisting a team of Buyers, Planners, Biddable Managers and Media Managers. They will support the ongoing planning, buying and execution of complex multi-channel media campaigns, across areas that include TV, VOD, Out of Home, display, audio, paid social and paid search. They will work across the full media lifecycle, from briefing media to launching campaigns to optimising performance to carrying out post-campaign data analysis.

Who we're looking for

We're not looking for previous experience in marketing, media or advertising. It's more important that you have the drive to learn, improve, adapt, and in time, take more of a leading role. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a landmark change in Armed Forces marketing, where media planning and buying for the Royal Navy, British Army and Royal Air Force comes together for the first time. We'll ask you to think both analytically and innovatively, to share your ideas and challenge yourself and others around you to deliver the best work. In return, you'll be immersed in a full-service integrated marketing agency, learning from passionate experts that are driving game-changing solutions every day.

We're looking for two Media Executives depending on what suits you best, you'll work within either the Planning or Biddable side of our Media team.

Planning:
- You'll research target audiences using tools, whitepapers and online sources, gaining insight into their geography, demographics, habits, interests, behaviours and media consumption.
- You'll meet and liaise with media suppliers, attending contract kick-offs, product pitches and performance reviews to be able to recommend the best media solution.
- You'll help put together media plans and presentations, with rationale and data analysis to demonstrate why the recommended strategy is the right one for the client.
- You'll help make campaigns the best they can be by writing briefs, quality-checking assets, sending bookings and raising purchase orders to different teams and suppliers.
- You'll help monitor campaigns, developing your data analysis skills and knowledge of media channels to understand what success looks like and communicate results to media suppliers to help improve performance.
- Take part in meetings with stakeholders and other departments, inputting into briefs, presentations, reports, reviews and showcases of our work.

Biddable:
- You'll support the setup and trafficking of digital campaigns across paid social, paid search and programmatic, ensuring all elements are quality checked and passed along within deadlines.
- You'll draft campaign tracking tag structures, maintaining agency taxonomy and naming conventions across files, campaigns and performance reports.
- You'll pull marketing performance reports and develop your data analysis skills to understand what success looks like, and to identify opportunities to optimise and improve results.
- You'll help monitor campaign pacing, spend and tracking so that any changes, improvements or events are recorded and correct.
- Take part in meetings with stakeholders and other departments, inputting into briefs, presentations, reports, reviews and showcases of our work.

The duties outlined in this job description are not definitive and you may be required to perform other duties at the request of your manager.

What's in it for me?

You're set to gain so much from being part of our team, including:
- Time off to rest or conquer items on the bucket list with 27 days' holiday (+ 8 bank holidays) and a holiday purchase benefit where you can buy up to an additional 5 days.
- Great company paid benefits including our health cash plan, life assurance, company pension and access to an Employee Assistance Programme.
- A hybrid working pattern plus other great flexible benefits such as a TechScheme, free mortgage advice and more.
- Individual development plans with customised learning solutions, including clear career pathways designed to support individual growth and career advancement.
- Excellent health benefits get cash back on your everyday healthcare costs with our flexible dental and cash plan benefits or grab some great discounts at your local gym.
- Opportunities to give back and care for our environment with eco-friendly benefits like our cycle to work scheme.

About us

Based in Bristol, TMP268 is a creatively strategic marketing agency full of curious, connected and clever problem solvers. Our focus is helping brands to grow.

As part of a Serco-led consortium the Armed Forces Recruitment Service we also hold the contract to deliver all marketing for British Army, Royal Navy and Royal Air Force recruitment.

TMP268 is part of PeopleScout, one of the leading Recruitment Process Outsourcing providers worldwide and part of the TrueBlue Inc Group.

Click the apply button and start your application today

We are an equal opportunities employer and positively encourage applications from persons regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

title: Business & Marketing Graduate
company: Elix Sourcing Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Business & Marketing Graduate

£28,000 per annum + Bonus + Training + Progression
Monday - Friday, 37.5 Hrs hour week - 1 day WFH after probation
Bristol

Are you a recent Business or Marketing graduate with a commercial mindset, a curious nature and the confidence to think independently?

If you enjoy solving problems, exploring new opportunities and turning your thinking into practical business recommendations, this could be the ideal next step in your career.

- £28,000 gross per annum + bonus

- Study support and company pension (up to 5% employer contribution + NI rebate).

- Casual office dress code and up to 4 company social events per year.
- Clear career progression into international sales, business development or commercial strategy

title: Digital Marketing & Performance Manager
description:
Take ownership of digital performance at Truespeed. Join our growing marketing team, turn insights into customer growth and help shape the next chapter of our expanding broadband business.

Digital Marketing & Performance Manager

Location: Bath
Salary: Up to £50,000 per annum
Contract: Full-time, permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home

About Truespeed

We're Truespeed, and we're growing fast!

Following our second merger in just 12 months, we've expanded from a mid-sized South West broadband provider into a national, multi-brand business, now reaching more than 420,000 homes across the South West, East of England, North West and West Midlands.

It's an exciting time to join our small, collaborative marketing team, with plenty of opportunity to share ideas, take ownership and make a real difference.

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you'll take ownership of our key performance marketing channels, particularly PPC and affiliate marketing, with a strong focus on turning website traffic into new customers.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who enjoys understanding customer behaviour, analysing performance and identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates.

You'll improve results through smarter targeting, better landing pages, stronger calls to action and an optimised customer journey. You'll also contribute to wider marketing strategy as our network and brands continue to grow.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and optimise PPC campaigns, including budget management, forecasting and performance against cost per acquisition (CPA), orders and return on advertising spend.
- Manage affiliate partnerships, including price comparison websites and networks, monitoring performance, lead quality, tracking and payouts.
- Manage regional, brand and non-brand PPC activity across our expanding network.
- Optimise landing pages and customer journeys, including building and updating pages in WordPress and applying SEO best practice.
- Analyse website, campaign and CRM data to understand traffic sources, lead quality and customer drop-off.
- Identify and deliver conversion rate optimisation (CRO) opportunities through testing, targeting and customer journey improvements.
- Manage external agencies and partners, ensuring activity delivers against agreed objectives.
- Produce weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights and recommendations for growth.
- Contribute to wider marketing strategy, including activity across our brands and customer retention.
- Monitor competitor activity and industry trends, sharing ideas and insights with the team.

About You

You're a commercially minded, proactive digital marketer who combines strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 3-4 years' experience in digital marketing, ideally in a performance or acquisition-focused role.
- Strong knowledge of PPC, SEO, paid social, UX and conversion rate optimisation.
- Experience managing multi-channel campaigns and delivering measurable results across leads, conversions, CPA and ROI.
- A good understanding of customer journeys, audience segmentation and targeted campaign delivery.
- Experience using website analytics, campaign data and CRM insights to inform decisions and improve performance.
- Confidence managing marketing budgets and forecasting.
- Experience briefing and managing external agencies or digital partners.
- Strong project management, communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A data-led mindset, with the confidence to challenge existing approaches and turn insights into practical recommendations.

Experience with WordPress would be an advantage.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary of up to £50,000 per annum.
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.
- Bath office location with free on-site parking.
- Private healthcare.
- A range of wellbeing, lifestyle and financial benefits, including 24/7 online GP access.

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Digital Marketing & Performance Manager position based in Bath, click "apply" today. You'll be directed to Truespeed's careers page, where you can find out more and complete your application.

Join us and help shape Truespeed's next chapter.

Please note: You must have valid authorisation to work in the United Kingdom, as we are unable to offer sponsorship for this position.

No agencies, please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Digital Marketing Manager, Performance Marketing Manager, PPC Manager, Paid Media Manager, Acquisition Marketing Manager, Growth Marketing Manager, Affiliate Marketing Manager, Conversion Rate Optimisation, SEO, Digital Marketing Jobs Bath.

title: Marketing Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: North Bristol/Hybrid working - office presence 4 days per week/remote 1 day

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000

We're looking for a Marketing Executive to join a growing business and play an important part in its marketing activity.

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone who enjoys getting involved in all aspects of marketing. From coordinating campaigns and creating content to managing social media, supporting events and looking at what's working, you'll help ensure marketing activity runs smoothly and makes a positive impact.

Working alongside colleagues across the business, as well as external agencies and suppliers, you'll help bring ideas to life, keep projects moving and make sure activity is delivered on time and to a high standard.

What you'll be doing
- Supporting the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Coordinating campaign schedules, deadlines and deliverables, keeping everyone involved up to date.
- Creating, coordinating and distributing marketing content, including emails, social media posts, blogs, newsletters and promotional materials.
- Keeping website content and marketing materials up to date.
- Managing and scheduling social media content, monitoring engagement and looking for opportunities to improve reach.
- Supporting email marketing activity, including maintaining databases and managing audience lists.
- Working with external content providers, designers and agencies to produce marketing materials.
- Helping to improve digital marketing activity through SEO, website analysis and performance monitoring.
- Supporting the organisation and promotion of events, managing logistics, suppliers and marketing materials.
- Maintaining marketing calendars, project trackers and budgets, alongside general supplier and invoice administration.
- Collecting and analysing marketing data, producing reports on campaign performance, website traffic and engagement.
- Working with different teams across the business to support wider marketing and commercial objectives.

What we're looking for

You'll have some previous experience in a marketing, communications or marketing support role and be comfortable juggling a variety of activities and deadlines.

We're looking for someone who has:
- A good understanding of digital marketing channels and how they work.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience using social media platforms and marketing tools.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- Great attention to detail and the ability to manage several priorities at once.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to use your initiative and take responsibility for getting things done.

It would also be useful if you have:
- A marketing qualification or degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related subject.
- Experience using CRM systems and email marketing platforms.
- Some knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics and website content management systems.
- Experience coordinating events and working with external suppliers.

The opportunity

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their marketing career in a varied role where no two days are quite the same.

You'll need to be organised, enthusiastic and comfortable working with different people across a business. Just as importantly, you'll enjoy getting stuck in, coming up with ideas and seeing projects through from start to finish.

If this sounds like the sort of role you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you ASAP as the client can interview quickly!

The client is looking to appoint someone quickly, so 2-3 month notice periods aren't ideal!

To find out more or apply, get in touch with Moxie & Mettle.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Performance Marketing Manager

Bristol / Hybrid (1 day per week office based)

Up to £48,000 Permanent, Full-time

An opportunity for a commercially minded Performance Marketing Manager with strong PPC expertise and a passion for turning campaign performance into measurable business results.

We're working with an established, growing B2 B business looking for someone who can take ownership of its digital marketing activity, drive quality lead generation and improve the performance of its digital channels.

This is a hands-on role combining PPC campaign management with wider digital marketing expertise across conversion optimisation, analytics, SEO, AEO/GEO and marketing automation.

You'll have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, take ownership of campaigns and budgets, and make a tangible difference to how digital marketing contributes to business growth.

About You

You'll bring:
- Significant hands-on PPC experience, particularly with Google Ads, including campaign strategy, bidding, keyword research and optimisation.
- A proven track record of delivering successful B2 B lead generation campaigns and improving acquisition performance.
- Experience with landing page optimisation, conversion rate optimisation and A/B testing.
- Good working knowledge of SEO, organic search and wider digital marketing channels.
- Experience using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
- Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, ideally HubSpot.
- The ability to interpret data, identify opportunities and turn insights into practical recommendations.
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities.

You'll be proactive, commercially minded and comfortable working independently, while enjoying collaboration with colleagues across marketing, sales and creative teams.

Experience within a technology-led or SaaS business would be advantageous; some previous agency experience would be useful too.

The Role

You'll be responsible for planning, delivering and optimising digital campaigns, with PPC and Google Ads at the heart of the role. You'll combine strategic planning with hands-on campaign management, taking ownership of budgets, performance and ongoing optimisation.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Owning PPC strategy and hands-on delivery, with Google Ads at the centre, alongside other paid search and social platforms where appropriate.
- Planning, building and optimising campaigns, including account structure, keyword research, audience targeting, ad copy, bidding strategies and negative keywords.
- Managing campaign budgets, forecasting performance and recommending how spend should be allocated to improve cost per qualified lead and contribute to the sales pipeline.
- Running structured tests across targeting, creative, bidding and landing pages, using performance data to continually improve results.
- Leading website and landing page optimisation, using CRO, A/B testing and user experience principles to improve conversion rates.
- Supporting wider organic visibility through SEO, keyword research and emerging AEO/GEO opportunities.
- Managing marketing automation and lead nurturing activity through HubSpot.
- Maintaining accurate campaign tracking and reporting through Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and advertising platform conversion tracking.
- Working closely with sales to understand lead quality and progression, using feedback to improve campaign performance.
- Reporting on results, presenting insights and making recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness and return on investment.

The Opportunity

You'll be joining an established and forward-thinking business with ambitious growth plans and a real appetite for developing its digital marketing activity.

There's plenty of scope to take ownership, bring new ideas to the table and shape how performance marketing develops, working closely with colleagues across the business.

If you're a digitally driven performance marketer who enjoys combining campaign delivery, data and strategy, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or get in touch with Moxie & Mettle for a confidential conversation.

title: PPC Executive - German Speaking
description:
Are you a recent German speaking Marketing graduate looking for your first role?

Or

Do you have existing PPC experience?

Are you looking for a fully remote and permanent role within the UK?

If so, APPLY NOW!

The Client:

An expanding and fast-moving Google Ads agency for D2 C brands across the UK and Europe. Most of their clients sell on Shopify. They don't just run the ads, they manage the whole system behind performance: data, structure, feeds and profit.

They are a fully remote, multilingual team, owning our accounts end to end. And they look after each other: flexible hours, unlimited leave, team retreats.

Google Partner. Shopify Partner. ProfitMetrics partner.

You'll own a portfolio of eCommerce accounts across European markets, with DACH at the centre. You'll know each client's margins, their hero products and what needs doing next.

More Detail:

- Set structure and governance across Performance Max and Demand Gen, and hold it
- Write and maintain scripts that catch problems early and save hours
- Find feed issues and disapprovals, and fix them

- Strong Google Shopping skills: Performance Max, Demand Gen governance, scripts

- Experience at a fully remote agency

- Using supplementary feeds to close data gaps

You don't need:

The Package:

- Fully remote, with a flexible schedule inside CET hours
- Pension
- Sick pay

If you are a fluent German speaker and are either a recent marketing graduate or have the hands-on PPC experience we are looking for, APPLY NOW in complete confidence, for immediate consideration.
